en.name: Chambermaid
en.ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
en.flavor: I aint seen nothin' untoward, Milady. Begging your pardon, but if I did see somethin', it certainly weren't the master o' the house sneaking into the professor's laboratory 'round eleven o'clock and mixing up fancy potions, just like you said, Miss.

zh.name: 侍女
zh.ability: 每个夜晚，你要选择除你以外的两名存活的玩家：你会得知他们中有几人在当晚因其自身能力而被唤醒。
